name: 12_greeting_barge_in
description: Greeting hook (scripted responder with a `greeting`): the assistant greets as turn 0 on connect; the caller starts 'Hi, where is my order' 0.8 s into the greeting, which must barge in and become turn 1 (greeting interrupted, never merged into the caller's text, no duplicate turn).
greeting: Hello, thanks for calling PulseNest support. You can ask about an order, a return, or any of our devices. How can I help you today?
replies: Your order PN-10002, the smart scale, shipped three days ago by BlueDart express. The tracking number is B D 7 7 8 1 2 0 4 I N. BlueDart expects to deliver it in about two days. You'll get an SMS from the courier on the day of delivery.
